title: theme index v0
description: A theme market's index (ADR 0060, docs/ko/theme-requirements.md TC-05): the themes one market offers, each with what its gallery card shows and where its .desk-theme bundle is, with the bundle's sha256 and size. The desk reads the indexes the setting desk.theme.markets lists; the first market lives in this repository (market/themes/index.json).

format.description: The index format and its version.

themes.description: The market's themes, each id once; built-in themes are never in an index.

ThemeIndexEntry.description: One theme of a market: its card and its bundle. The bundle's manifest has the same id, name and version.

license.description: An SPDX licence expression for the theme and its assets, for example CC0-1.0 or Apache-2.0.

preview.description: Up to five colours that stand for the theme on its card, the most telling first.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the bundle's bytes, lowercase hex: a download that differs is refused.

size.description: The bundle's size in bytes, 16 MiB at most.

ThemeIndexUrl.description: Where the theme's .desk-theme is: an https URL, or a path relative to the index's own URL without .. segments (paper-dusk.desk-theme), so a market moves by moving its folder.
